content: Hierarchical & Joint Model (H-Joint-2): 2-level hierarchical joint learning model that detects/extracts intent keywords & slots using seq2seq Bi-LSTMs first (Level-1), then only the words that are predicted as intent keywords & valid slots are fed into Joint-2 model (Level-2), which is another seq2seq Bi-LSTM network for utterance-level intent detection (jointly trained with slots & intent keywords) BIBREF1.
